depart: Come along. We're heading down to the south pole.
landed: Here we are. Take a look along the ridge. Shall we look for the Sun, or turn toward Earth?
sunLit: There it is. The whole Sun clears the ridge from here.
sunGrazing: See that thin edge of light? Only part of the Sun clears the ridge.
sunShadow: The Sun is in this direction, just out of sight behind the ridge.
earthUp: There’s home. From this spot, Earth peeks above the skyline.
earthDown: Home is that way. From this spot, the ridge hides Earth.
release: Take your time. I'll be here if you need me.
